name: Larimar
detailed_description:
Overview

A new Supervirus has infected the program Larimar! In a digital landscape where nothing is as it seems, you are the last hope to reclaim control. Hack into the game’s inner sanctum and battle through layers of corrupted code, infiltrating the Mainframe to neutralize the virus at its very core. Venture closer to the Servers and Datacenters deep within the Core, where each step brings you face-to-face with progressively more cryptic and glitchy adversaries. In this immersive cyber adventure, your skills, wits, and reflexes are put to the test in a race against time and overwhelming digital chaos.

• Dynamic Hacking System: Use an innovative interface that simulates real-time code manipulation, requiring both strategic planning and fast action.
• Progressive Enemy Complexity: Face a variety of digitally corrupted foes whose behaviors evolve as you get closer to the core.
• Environmental Storytelling: Explore vivid, neon-infused digital landscapes where every glitch and fragment tells a story of lost data and shattered protocols.
• Intuitive Controls: Master the art of digital combat with responsive controls designed for both keyboard and controller, making every hack feel visceral and immediate.
• Cinematic Visuals and Soundscapes: Experience an audio-visual feast that combines futuristic synths with breathtaking cybernetic imagery, pulling you deeper into Larimar’s unraveling narrative.

Embrace the challenge, harness your inner hacker, and let the pulse of the data stream guide you to victory over the Supervirus. Join the fight, rewrite the code, and reclaim a future free of digital darkness!
